comparisons.peer_summary: Data Center net revenue increased 94% to $12.6 billion in 2024 from $6.5 billion in 2023, primarily driven by higher sales of AMD Instinct GPUs and AMD EPYC CPUs. Operating income rose to $3.5 billion in 2024 from $1.3 billion in 2023, mainly due to higher revenue partially offset by increased R&D investment.
comparisons.comparison: Both QCOM and AMD attribute significant revenue growth in 2024 to specific high-demand product segments within their core operating areas. QCOM reported a $2.7 billion increase in equipment and services revenue from its QCT segment, while AMD reported a 94% increase (to $12.6 billion) in Data Center net revenue driven by AMD Instinct GPUs and EPYC CPUs. Both disclosures highlight that higher revenue was a primary driver of their respective financial performance improvements in these segments.
